summary: Getty Images Holdings, Inc. filed an 8-K Items 5.02/8.01 announcing the appointment of Elizabeth Abrams and Thomas Walper to its board effective July 20, 2026, and the resignation of Hilary Schneider. Abrams was also named to the Audit Committee. Appointments were made on the Nominating and Corporate Governance Committee's recommendation. Abrams and Walper entered independent director agreements receiving a $50,000 monthly fee plus additional compensation for extra time; Abrams receives an extra $10,000 monthly for Audit Committee service. Schneider's resignation was received the same date—no named successor or reason disclosed. Watch for potential strategic shifts or further board changes.
